Nemaksciai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kaunas County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Jews began settling in Nemakščiai in the 17th century, with 12 adult Jews recorded there in 1662; the population reached 954 (81 percent) by 1897. During WWI, retreating Russian troops notably failed to expel the local Jewish community, unlike their standard practice elsewhere. About 70 Jewish families remained when WWII began; after the German arrival, Jewish men over 15 were seized for forced labor and shot on July 24, 1941, and women and children were murdered that August.
